BERIDAA SHAAM KI GALIYO MEI SAFAR ZAINAB KA

SAR HAY PATHAR SE HUWA KHOON MEI TAR ZAINAB KA

GIR PARDHA KHAAK PE ABBAS KA SAR MAQTAL MEI

NOK E NEZA SE NA DEKHA GAYA SAR ZAINAB KA

NOK E NEZA PE BHI ROTA REHA SHABIR KA SAR

KAAT TA JATA THA MANZAR YEH JIGAR ZAINAB KA

HAR SEHAR ZULM NAYA AUR NAYI MUSHKIL HAR SHAAM

DARD BERTAA REHA HAR SHAAM O SEHAR ZAINAB KA

HAYE BAZAAR MEI ABID KO MASAIB WO MILLE

HO GAYA BUDHA JAWAANI MEI PISAR ZAINAB KA

EK RASSI MEI BANDHE DONO GALLE KHINJ TE TH

HAYE UDHAR BAALI SAKINA KA IDHAR ZAINAB KA

EH KHUDDA SAKTH MUSIBAT KI GARRI MEI HAY DUA

KAASH IMDAAD KO AA JAYA PADAR ZAINAB KA

KISKO AWAAZ BHALLA DEGI BULAAYEGI KISSE

HO CHUKA QATAL HAR EK NOOR E NAZAR ZAINAB KA

ARSALAN AZMI SAB KHAAK HUWE SHIMR O YAZEED

AB BHI DARBAAR MEI BAAKI HAY ASAR ZAINAB KA

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/safar-zainab-d8-b3-ka-fatemah-ladak-new-nohay-new-nw-16a49eae343d.md')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('ہائے ادھر بالی سکینہ کا ادھر زینب کا', 'ہائے اُدھر بالی سکینہ کا اِدھر زینب کا')
p.write_text(s)
before = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
meta, urdu = s.split('\\n---\\n', 1)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def verses(text):
    return [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()]
assert [x.casefold() for x in verses(roman)] == [x.casefold() for x in verses(before)]
assert len(verses(urdu)) == 18
assert re.findall(r'"'^([۰-۹])$'"', urdu, re.M) == list('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸')
assert re.findall(r'"'^  ([0-9])$'"', roman, re.M) == list('12345678')
PY"

Reconstructed all 18 verses in Urdu script and preserved the original Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have an opening couplet followed by eight numbered couplets. Updated the title and RTL metadata and removed `noUrdu`.

I read the abbreviated “khinj te th” as **کھنچتے تھے** and the poet’s surname “Azmi” as **عزمی**.
